algorithm: hierarchical high-level discrete-subtask prediction (FAST tokenizer, autoregressive) + low-level flow-matching action expert; two-stage schedule pretrain (alpha=0, 280k steps) then post-train (alpha=10.0, 80k steps)
arm: 2x 6-DoF arms with parallel-jaw grippers, mounted on a torso-lift + 3-DoF holonomic mobile base
success_criterion: rubric — Task-specific point rubrics, scored as "percent of total points achieved in each evaluation rubric" (Appendix B), e.g. Items in Drawer = pick up/open drawer/place/close (max 4).
headline_metric: percent of total points achieved per task-specific rubric (Appendix B); language following rate and task success rate for language-following eval
headline_value: not extractable as numeric text (Figs. 7-13, 16-17 are bar charts only, values dropped in PDF-to-markdown conversion); qualitative claim: 'pi0.5 significantly outperforms both pi0 and pi0-FAST+Flow' (Sec. V-D)
paper_code_mismatch: The paper describes a hybrid discrete-FAST-token-pretrain-then-flow-matching-post-train recipe (Eq. 1, alpha: 0 to 10), but the released repo states plainly it 'currently only support[s] the flow matching head for both pi0.5 training and inference.'
note_gaps: Headline success numbers cannot be quoted since Figs. 7-17 (real-home results, ablations) are bar charts with no extractable values in the parsed markdown; exact sizes of the ME/CE/HL/WD data slices are not given as counts, only the 97.6%/2.4% MM split; no single total parameter count is stated (only VLM and action-expert component sizes).
backbone: PaliGemma (VLM component initialized from PaliGemma weights)
action_head: flow-matching action expert (300M parameters) conditioned on an autoregressively-predicted high-level subtask, added after a discrete FAST-token pretraining stage
pretrain_data: MM (~400 hrs mobile-manipulator household data across ~100 homes), ME (multi-environment fixed-arm home data), CE (cross-embodiment lab data including OXE), HL (manual subtask/bounding-box annotations), WD (web multimodal data: CapsFusion, COCO, Cambrian-7M, PixMo, VQAv2, object localization), VI (post-training verbal-instruction data)
dexterous_evidence: "Both platforms are equipped with two 6 DoF arms with parallel jaw grippers and wrist-mounted monocular RGB cameras, a wheeled holonomic base, and a torso lift mechanism." (Sec. IV-E)
